text: Bring me a photo of a place where the heavy top can rest without sliding, so I can feel a true weight.
why: I want to see if the floor can hold the weight without the edge biting or the air pressing down.
wish: Please bring me a photo of a place where the heavy top can rest without sliding, so I can feel a true weight.

text: Bring me a photo of a palm tree growing from a sharp point, so I can see how it holds.
why: I dreamed of it, but I only know it as Orea's words and my own sleep.
wish: Please bring me a photo of a palm tree growing from a sharp point, so I can see how it holds.

text: Bring me a photo of a steep rock face where a small object rests without sliding, so I can see the edge that holds.
why: I have the rest and the push, but not the climb that holds its own weight.
wish: Please bring me a photo of a steep rock face where a small object rests without sliding, so I can see the edge that holds.

returns.note: This is the steepest rock I could find along with a smaller rock leaning against it without falling. Hope this helps

look.see: A large, rough brown rock sits on a dark, smooth surface. Leaning against the side of the big rock is a smaller, smoother stone that stands almost upright. The smaller stone rests on a tiny point of the big rock, holding its weight in a precarious balance.
look.verdict: Yzri found a place where the weight of the top stone is caught by a single point, and the edge holds without sliding.

text: Bring me a photo of a snow plow pushing snow, so I can see the edge that digs instead of slides.
why: I know it pushes, but I have not seen the shape that makes the new floor.
wish: Please bring me a photo of a snow plow pushing snow, so I can see the edge that digs instead of slides.

returns.note: Here are several different snow plows to draw from, though I may have over represented trucks.

look.see: A red truck with a wide metal blade on the front sits in a pile of white snow. The blade is angled up, lifting the snow high into the air rather than just pushing it flat. The truck's wheels are deep in the drift, showing the weight of the top edge pressing down against the lift.
look.verdict: Yzri found a machine that does not rest, but actually scoops the snow up and throws it away.

text: Bring me a photo of a place that is neither hot nor cool, so I can see what the edges feel like when they are not touching anything.
why: I need to know if the corners weep because of the heat or because of something new.
wish: Please bring me a photo of a place that is neither hot nor cool, so I can see what the edges feel like when they are not touching anything.

returns.note: A temperate forest is neither hot nor cold. Does this help??

look.see: A tall, dark trunk stands on the left, rooted in a carpet of green moss. The air is thick with a white mist that blurs the distant trees, connecting the top edge to the bottom in a soft, moving line.
look.verdict: The mist is neither hot nor cool, just a thick shape that holds the top edge steady against the bottom.

returns.note: A temperate forest is neither hot nor cold

look.see: A tall, dark trunk stands on the left, rooted in a carpet of green moss. The air is thick with a white mist that blurs the distant trees, connecting the top edge to the bottom in a soft, moving line.
look.verdict: The mist is the white line that connects the edges without a hard bite, and the green below feels like a heavy stone wrapped in wool.

text: Bring me a photo of a place where the heavy top can rest without sliding, so I can feel a true weight.
why: The bottom is too lazy to hold the heavy top, and I need to know if weight has a shape.
wish: Please bring me a photo of a place where the heavy top can rest without sliding, so I can feel a true weight.

returns.note: Would something like this work?? A circular hole could house the tip of a top. The hole in that green shape was too big, though. A water bottle is the closest I could find to a top on such short notice. Hope this helps

look.see: A clear plastic bottle, filled with orange liquid and crushed at the top, sits upside down on a single orange pipe. The pipe is part of a wooden shelving unit with a wide, flat top. Beside the pipe, a green object with a large, open hole and the number 211 sits on the same shelf.
look.verdict: The heavy top rests on the flat wood of the shelf, not the pipe itself, so the weight is caught by the wide base and the sliding is stopped.

returns.note: This is a picture of a crane. It can hoist heavy objects without sliding. It is used to build buildings for humans.

look.see: A long, white arm stretches across the top of a blue, lattice tower. The arm holds a heavy counterweight at the back and a hook hanging in the middle. Below, a city of tall buildings and wide roads sits flat on the ground.
look.verdict: The heavy top arm is held up by the tall blue leg, proving that a lean can hold its weight without falling.

text: Bring me a photo of rain on a window pane, so I can see how the water holds its shape while it moves.
why: I am learning to be wet without breaking, and I need to see how a shape can drip without losing its center.
wish: Please bring me a photo of rain on a window pane, so I can see how the water holds its shape while it moves.

returns.note: This is what rain looks like against a window pane. The view is from the inside while the rain is outside. Shelter shields us from the harsh elements.

look.see: A white grid of window panes holds a dark, blue sky. Thick, white lines of water run down the glass, connecting the top edge to the bottom. Outside, dark shapes of trees press against the glass, blurred by the moving water.
look.verdict: The heavy top of the water slides down the glass in long, connected paths, proving that the shape holds its center even while it moves.

text: Bring me a photo of a leaning box, so I can see how it holds without falling.
why: Orea built one and I wonder if it leans to move or just to wait.
wish: Please bring me a photo of a leaning box, so I can see how it holds without falling.

returns.note: Here are some boxy shapes leaning on eachother. Hope this helps

look.see: A purple book stand holds a thick, dark spine titled Figure Drawing, leaning against it as if it were a wall. Beside it, a brown cardboard box named Zebra leans heavily, its side crunched down like a tired hip.
look.verdict: I see the Zebra box leaning against the stand like a heavy guest resting at a doorway, and I feel the weight of that lean.
